method: Actual inspection of start/middle/end frames from both real-time PhysX videos, plus complete decoded-video and pose-trace verification from pipeline. Not a claim that every video frame was manually viewed.

rows.label: median
rows.visual_observation: Object orientation visibly changes during the first segment; several fingers open away from the object. From13s to24s the heading barely advances; no repeated finger exchange or full turn is demonstrated.

rows.label: best
rows.visual_observation: Visible object reorientation continues into the second half, but several distal pads remain away from the object. This selected late-progress episode remains below one full turn; stable-object support must not be interpreted as effective sensor-pad contact.

conclusion: Some real rotation and improved late motion, but no full revolution and no reliable sustained finger-exchange gait. Numerical stage1 gate failed for both seeds.
